newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe industrials firm but some correction seen.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe industrials firm but some correction seen.

text.p: Zimbabwe industrial shares finished Tuesday stronger but dealers said that the stock market could still see a further correction.
"It's looking firmer again but it still seems to be under some correction pressure," one dealer said.
"There were a few gains but it's not going up in the trends that it has been," he added.
The 57-counter industrial index closed 34.98 points higher at 10,044.46.
Dealers said reasonable volume had been seen but that it had room for improvement.
"The market is still a bit sluggish," a dealer said.
Zimpapers added 200 cents to 2,900, Miekles put on 50 cents to 2,100, Truworths was up 50 cents to 1,150 and CAPS added 120 cents to 850 cents.
Mining shares inched up on the day to close 11.22 points higher at 976,31.
Wankie put on five cents to 505, Rio Tinto rose 100 cents to 2,100 cents. But Ashanti lost 200 cents to 9,800 cents.
